'''Qalydon''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Qalydon system/Legends|Qalydon system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim's]] [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]]. The planet served as the headquarters of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]].

{{Planet-stub}}

==Description==
Qalydon was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE" /> located in the [[Qalydon system/Legends|Qalydon system]], a part of the [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Qalydon's surface was covered in [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]].<ref name="Gap" />

==History==
Qalydon served as the headquarters of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]].<ref name="CSWE" /> Around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Revanite crisis]], [[Archaeologist/Legends|archaeologists]] discovered hieroglyphs carved into stone walls at the feet of mountains on Qalydon which depicted the cultural rise of the inhabitants&mdash;except for one untouched [[Unidentified Qalydon mountain|mountain]].<ref name="Gap" /> The world was connected to the [[New Sith Wars]], which were at times called the "Curse of Qalydon".<ref name="END">{{Hyperspace|url=hyperspace/member/insideronline/88/indexp2.html|text=''Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties''|int=Evil Never Dies: The Sith Dynasties}}</ref>

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Pello Scrambas]] visited the world when it served as a [[Battle of Qalydon|battlefront]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Scrambas DB">{{DB|character|pelloscambras|Scrambas, Pello}}</ref>

By [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], the world was part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Journal 13" /> In 2 ABY,<ref name="2 ABY">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}} &mdash; [[Sektor 242 NewsLine]] transmitted [[NewsNet]] report from [[Port Fyrin]] on Qalydon on the date 38:2:9, which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> [[High Reverend]] [[Massus Gyne]] of the Fellowship of Kooroo issued a bounty for [[Andor Javin]], a [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] after Javin made claims disparaging the Fellowship and their beliefs. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 38:2:9, the [[Sektor 242 NewsLine]] transmitted a report from Port Fyrin on Qalydon. In the report, it was mentioned that few [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] within any guild expressed interest in the assignment, despite the 20,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] the Fellowship was offering for Javin's demise.<ref name="Journal 13" />

==Behind the scenes==
Qalydon was first mentioned in the "[[Galaxywide NewsNets]]" feature of [[West End Games]]' [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 13|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 13]], written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]], and published in [[May]] [[1997]].<ref name="Journal 13" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the world in grid square R-5.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
